population: ordinary Manual 177 images / 22 buildings, local 9 and 12 degree affinity partitions
primary_outcome: pair belongs to the same local cluster; same point count is NOT a prospective predictor
auxiliary_outcome: worker belongs to the unique largest local cluster; ties are an explicitly unknown auxiliary target
outer_split: leave target building out of all worker profile estimation and response-type model training
inner_features: each training example uses worker profiles excluding BOTH outer target building and the example's own building, provided by nested_fold_features.csv; no own-answer Q leakage
Q_absolute: mean absolute B8L2 from ordinary Manual history excluding outer and inner buildings; task-mix-sensitive baseline
Q_relative: task-adjusted worker B8L2 effect; pair symmetric mean and absolute difference
QT: Q_relative plus same-task source log-time effect; target-specific time remains separate and is not imputed from source time
QTD: QT plus target-difficulty worker-effect minus general worker-effect, supported difficulty only; observable frozen difficulty enters baseline
QTD_origin_time: QTD with source-origin-adjusted relative time replacing pooled relative time; held-out predictions also stratified old/old, new/new and mixed workers
QTD_behavior: QTD plus separately smoothed old-strong and new-reported Semi unchanged-error opportunity fractions, and historical scope out-answer propensity. These remain behavior predictors, not Q; no scope ability or error-free claim. No merged evidence denominator.
worker_pair_history: training same-pair coassignment counts, additive strength 5 toward training difficulty prevalence; actual historical joint behavior benchmark, not a portable worker class
classifier: fixed logistic L2 C=1, lbfgs, max_iter=500; train-only median encoding and missing indicators, train-weighted centering/scaling; original missing values remain null in source/results
training_weights: equal buildings, equal images inside building, equal pairs or workers inside image; weights sum to training image count so repeated pairs do not determine regularization strength
evaluation: held-out Brier and log loss aggregated pairs/workers -> image -> building; building bootstrap 3000 draws seed 2026101921; calibration/AUC diagnostic
sensitivity: report actual same-point-count subset retrospectively, source cohort panels, and existing room-group weights without synthesizing relationships
selection_rule: no tuning against local-cluster prediction scores or fusion outcome; all registered models reported, null and worse results retained
interpretation: predicting local style choice/coassignment differs from predicting quality; neither establishes permanent natural classes nor exchangeability by itself
